metaTitle: Custom Unisex Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom unisex drawstring backpacks in bulk for your team or event. Fast turnaround, screen printing & embroidery available. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Unisex drawstring backpacks offer a versatile silhouette that works for any gender, making them a smart choice for company picnics, trade shows, or employee welcome kits. The simple cinch closure and lightweight polyester body keep costs low while providing a generous main compartment for giveaways or personal items. Add your logo with screen printing or embroidery for a clean, professional look that appeals to everyone in your group.
heroAltText: Custom unisex drawstring backpacks in assorted colors with logo imprint, ideal for corporate events and bulk orders.
